scope: Completed 304-question raw-source development readers only; excludes retrieval, extraction and judge calls.
method: Sum turn.completed usage across every retained request event log, including failed validation attempts; separately sum accepted-answer usage. Percentiles use nearest rank over accepted-answer invocation wall times.
limitations: Input usage includes Codex bootstrap instructions and retrieved context. Cached input is a subset of input, not additional tokens. Wall times reflect concurrent host pressure, network and Codex startup, not native retrieval latency or controlled throughput. No monetary cost is inferred.
